page_title: JUV 1-0 VER | Juventus v Verona 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Referee Ermano Feliciani has finally had enough of Massimiliano Allegri and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+8' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+7' 1 - 0 Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is first to get to the rebound after a goalmouth scramble and finds the back of the net from point-blank range.
90+7' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) latches on to a nice cross and directs a header at goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball only hits the right post.
90+5' It will be a substitution. Diego Coppola (Verona) is ready to enter the pitch as Filippo Terracciano walks off.
90+4' Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
90+3' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) goes on a mazy run, gets into the box and from around the penalty spot he misses the target. What a chance that was!
90+2' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Chiesa (Juventus).

90' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
89' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
87' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) replacing Daniele Rugani.
87' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Federico Bonazzoli.
84' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) meets a brilliant cross and steers a fine header goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post.
82' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
82' Here is a change. Dusan Vlahovic is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
80' A player from Verona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
77' A pass into the penalty area from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is intercepted by the defence.
73' Here comes a substitution. Tomas Suslov (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Martin Hongla.
73' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Davide Faraoni is replaced by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona).
73' Substitution. Darko Lazovic (Verona) replaces Josh Doig.
72' Federico Gatti (Juventus) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
71' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) picks up an injury.
69' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
68' 19:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
64' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

64' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lorenzo Montipo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Substitution. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) on for Filip Kostic.
62' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Moise Kean will be replaced by Federico Chiesa (Juventus).
62' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
61' Great touch by Fabio Miretti (Juventus) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
58' Bremer (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for an infringement.
56' Moise Kean (Juventus) picks up a yellow card.
55' The goal by Juventus is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
54' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Juventus players aren’t happy.
53' Moise Kean (Juventus) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the left post.
51' Federico Gatti (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Ermano Feliciani lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.

50' Nice move, nice attempt! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
49' Moise Kean (Juventus) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
48' Filip Kostic (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Massimiliano Allegri makes a half-time substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) comes on in place of Timothy Weah.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The ball is crossed into the box and Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom right corner, but Wojciech Szczesny gets a glove on it to thwart him.
45+1' The free kick finds Milan Djuric (Verona) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ermano Feliciani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Gatti (Juventus) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Verona.
42' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) sees a yellow card from Ermano Feliciani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
38' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Milan Djuric (Verona) for a tough tackle.
36' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
36' Moise Kean (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Martin Hongla (Verona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Looks like Martin Hongla (Verona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Moise Kean (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
31' Martin Hongla (Verona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
30' Federico Gatti (Juventus) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
28' Moise Kean (Juventus) jumps into a tackle and Ermano Feliciani signals a foul.
27' Milan Djuric (Verona) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
27' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Federico Gatti (Juventus) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
26' Filip Kostic (Juventus) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
25' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul after Michael Folorunsho (Verona) hacks down one of his opponents.
24' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Verona as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
23' There's a break in play and referee Ermano Feliciani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Verona using VAR. This could be interesting!
23' That looked a certain handball by Timothy Weah (Juventus) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

19' What a miss! Moise Kean (Juventus) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

19' Moise Kean (Juventus) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the roof of the net fails to beat Lorenzo Montipo, who makes a fine save. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
17' Davide Faraoni (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
14' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Juventus players aren’t happy.

13' The defending players give Moise Kean (Juventus) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 1:0.
11' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.

8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo!
5' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
4' Weston McKennie (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Weston McKennie (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
